entries.label: Magic Leap
entries.quote: A startup is betting more than half a billion dollars that it will dazzle you with its approach to creating 3-D imagery.
entries.note: Breakthrough field: "A device that can make virtual objects appear in real life."

entries.label: Nano-Architecture
entries.quote: A Caltech scientist creates tiny lattices with enormous potential.

entries.label: Car-to-Car Communication
entries.quote: A simple wireless technology promises to make driving much safer.

entries.label: Project Loon
entries.quote: Billions of people could get online for the first time thanks to helium balloons that Google will soon send over many places cell towers don't reach.

entries.label: Liquid Biopsy
entries.quote: Fast DNA-sequencing machines are leading to simple blood tests for cancer.

entries.label: Megascale Desalination
entries.quote: The world's largest and cheapest reverse-osmosis desalination plant is up and running in Israel.

entries.label: Apple Pay
entries.quote: A service that makes it practical to use your smartphone as a wallet in everyday situations.

entries.label: Brain Organoids
entries.quote: A new method for growing human brain cells could unlock the mysteries of dementia, mental illness, and other neurological disorders.

entries.label: Supercharged Photosynthesis
entries.quote: Advanced genetic tools could help boost crop yields and feed billions more people.

entries.label: Internet of DNA
key_players: Global Alliance for Genomics and Health
entries.quote: A global network of millions of genomes could be medicine's next great advance.

notes: Ten entries. Web date 2015-02-18. Each article has Breakthrough / Why It Matters / Key Players fields but no Availability field. Quote is the article dek. Person names dropped from key players. Read through a summarising fetch per article; medium confidence.
